title: VapeCase iolite Quarantine Series
description:
This small airtight case is designed just for your Iolite vaporizer, it is airtight and watertight.

Can be used for other small vaporizers and 510 batteries.

You can store your vaporizer and all your accessories in one spot neatly and conveniently. These cases can take some impact while protecting your investment. Low profile design makes storage easy.
